items.title_en: Man and woman who tied themselves together for a year but were not allowed to touch revealed staggering findings
items.title_zh: 男女将自己绑在一起一年但不准触摸，结果令人震惊
items.summary_en: A man and woman who were tied together for a whole year have opened up about what they discovered during the bizarre collaboration. Tehching Hsieh, a painter and performance artist, and Linda Montano, also a performance artist, bound themselves together with an eight-foot rope tied at their waists, but were not allowed to touch one another for the entire 12 months. The aim of the art collaboration, titled Rope Piece, was to explore issues like freedom, privacy, control, and commitment, as well as the way humans…
items.summary_zh: 一对在一起了一整年的男人和女人公开了他们在这次奇怪的合作中发现的事情。画家兼行为艺术家谢德庆 (Tehching Hsieh) 和行为艺术家琳达·蒙塔诺 (Linda Montano) 用一根 8 英尺长的绳子绑在腰间，将自己绑在一起，但在整个 12 个月内不允许彼此接触。这次名为“绳子”的艺术合作的目的是探索自由、隐私、控制和控制等问题。
